BiblicalUsage: Puk means dye, paint for the eyes, stibium. Jezebel painted her face and tired her head, and looked out at a window, and Jeremiah asks the faithless city, Though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair. But to afflicted Zion God says, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that painting cuts both ways: Jezebel painted to seduce and was thrown from the window, and God paints Zion's foundations with sapphires, because He beautifies what He redeems.
